_comment: SE2 Online Linux headless egg. SteamCMD downloads/updates game AppID 1133870 in the persistent server volume at startup; game files are not included in the public image.
name: Space Engineers 2 - SE2 Online Linux
author: 24536501+EspGCreunix@users.noreply.github.com
description: SE2 Online dedicated server on native Linux through Pulsar/LinuxCompat. Downloads and updates Space Engineers 2 through SteamCMD on server start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
for bin in curl bash; do command -v "$bin" >/dev/null || { echo "Missing installer tool: $bin"; exit 1; }; done
curl -fL --retry 3 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EspGCreunix/se2online-pterodactyl/main/install-server.sh -o /tmp/se2online-install.sh
bash /tmp/se2online-install.sh

variables.name: Server Config Path
variables.description: Path to the SE2 Online server configuration file.

variables.name: Game2 Directory
variables.description: Game2 directory inside the automatically managed Steam installation.

variables.name: Pulsar Directory
variables.description: Pulsar Linux directory installed by the egg.
